title: ModuleTaskProviderConfigAdapter
responsibility: Discover the minimum trusted provider configuration and rule paths for an isolated task launch without reading credential contents.

inputs.name: constructor.config
inputs.description: Optional absolute synthetic roots for tests; default current host home and provider-specific config environment.

outputs.name: paths
outputs.description: Returns existing canonical regular credential/config files and, for Codex, only the exact rules directory plus individual *.rules files. Never returns unrelated siblings or copies file contents.

errors.name: unsafe config path
errors.description: Reject symlink or hardlink aliases that could widen access; absence of optional files or directory is not an error.
